title: Shared menu items and tabs at phone width: DropdownMenuItem is 32 px and TabsTrigger 38 px tall, below the 44 px minimum, in every menu and tab strip the mobile app shows
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

Filing gate: ① user-visible defect with a named location, class b, an out-of-scope finding from #29071's phone run (os-dev report 6573777431, PR #29210), a child of the #29040 audit · filed by `domain:ui#4` · ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** The mobile app 2.0 hosts the Console in a WebView (objectstack-ai/mobile#144), so every overflow menu, row-action menu and tab strip a phone user taps is a shared `@object-ui/components` primitive. #29040 sets 44 px as the minimum touch target. The per-flow children (#29070, #29071, #29072) fixed their own controls, but they left the shared primitives alone, so the defect recurs on every page: record "more" menus, list row actions, record tabs and Studio tabs.

**Location (at `origin/main`).**
- `ui/packages/components/src/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx:94` (`DropdownMenuItem`), and the checkbox and radio items at `:110` and `:134`: `py-1.5 text-sm` with no minimum height, measured 32 px tall.
- `ui/packages/components/src/ui/tabs.tsx:25` (`TabsList`, `h-10`) and `:40` (`TabsTrigger`, `py-1.5`): the trigger measured 38 px tall.

**reach:** measured in a real browser at 375×812 and 390×844 by #29071's os-dev on the CRM and showcase record pages: the `DropdownMenuItem` row is 32 px and the record `TabsTrigger` is 38 px.

**Wanted.**
1. At phone width, `DropdownMenuItem` (and the checkbox and radio items) and `TabsTrigger` reach 44 px of tap height. Use the same responsive token the form widgets use in #29072 (`min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0`, or its shared helper if #29072 lands one), so the desktop density is unchanged. `TabsList` grows with its triggers on a phone.
2. Do not move the visible text or icon on desktop, and do not change any export or prop.
3. One test per primitive pins the phone class, and a phone-viewport check on one record page confirms it.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`, size S. It runs after #29072 (PR #29209) lands if it reuses its token or helper.

**Dedupe.** Searched `DropdownMenuItem touch target` (1 hit: #29071) and `tabs touch target phone` (no primitive card). #29107 (Dialog close) and #29078 (Sheet close) cover other primitives, not these.

Links back: #29040, #29071, PR #29210, #29072, #29107, #29078.
